game.artifact_error: The original-core game files are missing or failed verification. This page cannot start a game.
game.audio_help: This edition uses a character display and has no audio.
game.browser_help: A browser supporting WebAssembly stack switching (JSPI) is required.
game.credit: DRL © Kornel Kisielewicz / ChaosForge · Licenses and source code
game.exited: The game has closed. Reload this page to launch again.
game.files_synced: The completed native file changes are stored in this browser.
game.input_error: The input could not be delivered to the original game.
game.intro: Play the original DRL with its character display.
game.jspi_error: This browser lacks WebAssembly stack switching (JSPI). Use a browser that supports WebAssembly.Suspending and WebAssembly.promising.
game.keyboard_help: Arrows move; Home, End, PgUp and PgDn move diagonally. Esc opens the game menu. Click the screen to control the game.
game.locale_help: Changing the display language affects text drawn by the game next. Text size changes and replaying the screen do not advance the game RNG.
game.locale_pending: Language selected. Newly drawn game text will use this language.
game.no_save: There are no saved native files in this browser.
game.ready: Ready. Launch the game or restore the saved native files.
game.running: Game running. Use Esc for the original game menu.
game.runtime_error: The game stopped because of a runtime error. Diagnostic details are available in the browser console.
game.save_help: Choose Save & Quit in the Esc menu to write a native save and store it in this browser. Next time, choose Launch saved game, then resume from the game's own menu. Closing the tab alone does not save a running game.
game.save_pending: Choose Save & Quit in the original menu. Storage completes after the native save finishes.
game.saved: The completed native save is stored in this browser.
game.storage_error: The completed native files could not be stored. Keep this tab open and choose Retry storage.
game.storage_read_error: Stored native files could not be read or verified. A fresh launch is available; restoring is disabled.
game.text_entry_help: Committed text is sent to the game. Press Enter to confirm.
game.title: DRL — Browser edition
game.touch_help: Buttons send the standard keys. Any bindings changed in the game still apply. On a small screen, scroll the game display horizontally.
